usedFor: Shopify holds the store, orders and checkouts, and DaySchedule receives each shopper as a contact through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Contact” in DaySchedule
bestTemplate.why: An abandoned checkout carries the shopper's email or phone, so a contact is ready for a booking follow-up.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so contacts appear after a scheduled check, not at the moment of abandoning.
